end.line: Quillon for Ravensworth’s private client team

vo: Ravensworth’s private client team looks after two hundred and fifty trusts and estates, and checks every deed by hand.
When a family emails a question, Quillon drafts the reply in Outlook, citing the trust deed it relies on.
Ask whether a deed matches the letter of wishes, and the answer comes back cited to the exact page.
Quillon redlines the draft deed in Word against your playbook, so every change shows its reason.
Eleanor will walk your team through it on Wednesday the twenty-fifth.
